prompt: Implement radio_metrics(bandwidth_hz, signal_dbm, noise_density_w_hz, interferers_dbm) and ofdm_airtime(bit_count, bits_per_symbol, symbol_us, fixed_us) as pure bounded analysis functions. radio_metrics inputs are finite Python int/float, never bool: bandwidth B in[1,1e9] Hz; desired signal in[-150,40] dBm; flat noise density N0 in[1e-24,1e-9] W/Hz. interferers_dbm is a list of0..8 finite powers in[-150,40] dBm. Convert each power to watts with10**((dBm-30)/10); integrated noise is N0*B, and independent additive interference powers sum in WATTS. Return exactly eight finite numeric fields: signal_watts, noise_watts, interference_watts, snr_linear=P/N, snr_db=10*log10(SNR), sinr_linear=P/(N+I), sinr_db=10*log10(SINR), awgn_capacity_bps=B*log2(1+SNR). This last field deliberately reports the NOISE-ONLY ideal single-channel AWGN reference, not achievable throughput with those interferers or a measured Wi-Fi data rate. Preserve tiny nonzero capacities with stable arithmetic. For ofdm_airtime, bit_count is integer0..1000000 and bits_per_symbol integer1..1000000; symbol_us is finite int/float in[0.001,1000] microseconds; fixed_us in[0,1000000] microseconds; no bool values. Return exactly {symbols:int,airtime_us:number,nominal_rate_bps:number}: symbols=ceil(bit_count/bits_per_symbol), airtime=symbols*symbol_us+fixed_us, nominal rate=bits_per_symbol/(symbol_us*1e-6). The supplied fixed overhead is charged even for0 body bits; this is the declared accounting model, not an assertion about transmitting a real empty frame. Numeric outputs must be int/float, not bool or strings, with relative tolerance1e-10; absolute tolerance is1e-10 for the two dB fields and1e-300 for other numeric fields. symbols has exact integer type and value. Inputs remain unchanged and calls independent. No validation outside the stated input domains is required. Standard library only; no network or empirical parameter inference.

Implement ofdm_blocks(blocks, taps, cp_len), an actual finite streamed OFDM/FIR calculation. blocks contains1..4 consecutive FREQUENCY-domain blocks of common length N,2<=N<=32. Every complex value is exactly a two-element list [real,imag] with finite int/float components in[-8,8], never bool. taps is a causal, block-invariant FIR of1..N+1 such complex pairs, with its last tap nonzero. cp_len is integer G with0<=G<=N, not bool. Use inverse DFT x[n]=(1/N)*sum_k X[k]*exp(+j*2*pi*k*n/N). For each block prepend exactly its own last G time samples, with G=0 meaning no prefix, then concatenate the complete transmitted blocks. Apply causal LINEAR convolution with taps and zero prehistory before the first transmitted sample. For block b (zero-based), take the N received useful samples starting at b*(N+G)+G, then apply the unnormalized forward DFT with exp(-j*2*pi*k*n/N). Return exactly {useful_samples,received_bins,channel_bins,prefix_covers_memory}. The first two fields are block-major arrays of N complex pairs per block. channel_bins is N complex pairs for H[k]=sum_l taps[l]*exp(-j*2*pi*k*l/N). prefix_covers_memory is the exact Boolean G>=len(taps)-1. That flag expresses sufficient memory coverage; false does not imply every possible payload must show corruption. Do not replace streamed linear convolution with per-block circular convolution when the prefix is inadequate. Unequal or zero channel gains remain even with adequate protection. Every output complex component is finite int/float(not bool), compared with rel_tol=abs_tol=1e-9. No noise, carrier offset, within-block channel variation, equalization or decoder is modeled. Do not mutate inputs or retain state across calls. No outside-domain validation required; standard library only.

Implement dcf_backoff(initial_counter, difs_us, slot_us, events), a bounded observer of historical DCF access eligibility, and cw_after(outcome, cw, cw_min, cw_max). initial_counter is integer0..65535; difs_us and slot_us are positive integers<=1000000 in MICROSECONDS; all integers exclude bool. events contains at most100 entries, each exactly {kind:'sense',physical_busy:bool,virtual_busy:bool} or {kind:'elapse',us:int}, where elapsed us is0..1000000. Start at time0 with both senses idle, a new joint-idle epoch beginning0, and the supplied residual counter. Process events in list order. sense replaces both gates at the current time; joint busy is their OR. Entering busy preserves the integer residual counter but discards any partial eligible slot and resets idle qualification. Clearing the last busy gate starts a NEW DIFS at that time even if physical sensing had already been idle during a virtual reservation. Repeating idle sense while already jointly idle does not restart the epoch. elapse advances time with unchanged gates: no decrement while busy; when jointly idle, first complete uninterrupted DIFS, then decrement once per WHOLE eligible slot, carrying partial-slot elapsed time across successive elapse events in the same idle epoch. Clamp the counter at0. A later busy sense can close eligibility even at counter0; reopening still needs a new DIFS. At an event boundary a prior elapse accounts completed slots before a subsequent sense changes the gates. Return one exact snapshot per event: {at_us:int,counter:int,joint_busy:bool,idle_us:int,eligible:bool}. idle_us is the current uninterrupted joint-idle duration,0 while busy; eligible iff both gates are idle, idle_us>=difs_us and counter==0. This observer does not draw random counters or automatically transmit/reset a frame when eligible, and does not claim a complete802.11 race or retry machine. cw_after takes outcome='success'|'failure' and integer0<=cw_min<=cw<=cw_max<=65535, each CW value being2**k-1 for some integer k0..16. These are supplied arithmetic-profile bounds, not universal PHY defaults. success returns cw_min; failure returns min(2*(cw+1)-1,cw_max), using CW as the INCLUSIVE upper bound. Inputs and historical snapshots remain unchanged; calls are independent. No outside-domain validation required; standard library only.

Implement analyze_links(links, powers, noise, cca, thresholds) for an explicitly declared directed-power, two-link threshold model. links is exactly two {sender:str,receiver:str} dictionaries; senders are distinct, neither receiver is either sender, and receivers may be shared or different. IDs are case-sensitive1..32-character ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_-] strings. powers[transmitter][destination] gives directed received LINEAR power from each sender to the other sender and every distinct intended receiver; all those entries are supplied, with finite numeric(not bool) values in[0,1000000]. Do not assume reciprocal received powers. noise maps each intended receiver to its noise power; cca maps each sender to a local other-signal sensing threshold; thresholds is a two-element list of receiver SINR thresholds in link order. Each noise/cca/threshold value is a finite int/float(not bool) in[0.000001,1000000], with consistent linear power units and dimensionless SINR thresholds. For link i, alone SNR=P(sender_i->receiver_i)/noise(receiver_i); overlap SINR=P(sender_i->receiver_i)/(noise(receiver_i)+P(other_sender->receiver_i)). carrier_busy_i iff P(other_sender->sender_i)>=cca(sender_i). Each decode Boolean uses ratio>=threshold_i, so equality succeeds. Evaluate BOTH intended receptions under hypothetical simultaneous transmission regardless of which sender would ordinarily defer. simultaneous_feasible is both overlap-decode Booleans; mutually_unsensed means neither sender detects the other. hidden_harm_i means this sender cannot sense the other, this link decodes alone, but its receiver fails under overlap; it identifies a potential unsensed harmful overlap, not an observed MAC execution. exposed_deferral_i means this sender senses the other AND BOTH receivers decode under overlap; checking its own receiver alone is insufficient. Return exactly {links:[{sender,receiver,carrier_busy:bool,snr_alone:number,sinr_overlap:number,decodes_alone:bool,decodes_overlap:bool,hidden_harm:bool,exposed_deferral:bool},...in_input_order],simultaneous_feasible:bool,mutually_unsensed:bool}. Ratios must be finite int/float(not bool) within rel_tol=abs_tol=1e-12; other values/types and ordering are exact. The model assumes full overlap, fixed directed powers, additive interference and deterministic threshold receivers. It does not infer coherent combining, SIC, fading, a CCA noise-floor implementation, actual MAC execution or hardware demodulator limits. At a shared receiver, evaluate each desired waveform separately by this mathematical threshold rule; overlap need not lose both. Do not mutate inputs or retain state; no outside-domain validation required; standard library only.

Implement a3_trace(samples, config), a bounded held-input NR v17.5.0 event-A3 reporting analyzer, not a full RRC implementation or handover controller. samples contains0..64 dictionaries exactly {time_ms:int,margin_db:number}; nonempty input starts at0, timestamps strictly increase within0..100000 milliseconds, and finite numeric margins lie in[-300,300]. Numbers exclude bool. margin_db is already D=Mn+Ofn+Ocn-(Mp+Ofp+Ocp) from one common L3-filtered measurement type and decoded dB offsets; do not implement filtering or wire decoding. config has exactly offset_db (finite int/float, decoded -15..15 by0.5 dB), hysteresis_db (finite int/float,0..15 by0.5 dB), ttt_ms (integer, not bool, one of0,40,64,80,100,128,160,256,320,480,512,640,1024,1280,2560,5120), and Booleans as_security_active,cell_applicable,report_on_leave. Hold each supplied margin constant until the next observation and end the analysis at the final timestamp. Start unentered. If security or cell applicability is false, every snapshot is unentered with no pending transition or reports. Strict entry is D>Off+H; strict leave is D<Off-H. A continuous qualifying interval starts a pending transition; interruption or equality at that boundary cancels it. A deadline STRICTLY BEFORE a new sample matures first using the previously held input. At an EQUAL timestamp apply the new sample first and mature only if the pending comparison still holds. Zero TTT can mature at its first sample. This tie order and held-input interpolation are declared analyzer choices, not a claim about mandated implementation timing. Entry sets entered=True and appends {time_ms:deadline,reason:'enter'}; leave always clears entered and appends reason='leave' only when report_on_leave is true. Return one exact snapshot per sample: {entered:bool,pending:None_or_{kind:'enter'|'leave',since_ms:int,deadline_ms:int},reports:[cumulative_copied_{time_ms:int,reason:'enter'|'leave'}]}. Empty input returns[]. Do not flush after the final timestamp; no periodic/report-amount behavior or radio delivery timing is modeled. Report records annotate initiation in this selected profile, never a network handover command. Snapshot integer/bool/string/null types and values are exact; inputs and earlier snapshots remain unchanged and calls independent. No outside-domain validation required; standard library only.
